name: ChurchBox
shortDescription: A UK cloud church-management system with a free address-book tier and paid modules for rotas, events, member communications and shared resources.
suitableContexts: Churches wanting a free starting point for a member directory and communications
Teams that need rotas and event registration without a complex all-in-one suite
Churches willing to pay per user annually for additional administration modules

pricing.summary: ChurchBox publishes a free account with unlimited users for the address book, groups and communications. Its Full Version is £1 per user per year plus VAT, charged in blocks of ten users, for rotas, events, files and pages. Confirm fair-use limits, total inclusive VAT, renewal and any module conditions before purchase.

startingPrice.qualifier: Per user, excluding VAT; charged in blocks of ten users

tiers.label: Free Account
tiers.detail: Unlimited users, address book, groups, communications, directory, import and export features stated by supplier

tiers.label: Full Version
tiers.detail: Charged in blocks of ten users; adds rotas, events, files and pages

dataHosting: ChurchBox describes the service as fully managed and hosted in the cloud. Its currently published public materials do not establish the hosting provider, data-storage location, sub-processors, backups, recovery objectives or service levels; obtain these in the current data-processing agreement before importing member data.
gdprInformation: ChurchBox describes the church as controller and ChurchBox as processor for data held in the service, and says a data-processing agreement is available through an instance's Admin Area and welcome email. It also publishes consent, directory-visibility and deletion features. Ask for the current agreement and security, incident, retention and sub-processor documentation before use.
coreFeatures: Member address book and online directory
Event registration with custom fields and downloadable registrations
Shared files and controlled member pages
CSV/Excel-oriented data import and group export
importExport: Supplier publishes an importer for spreadsheet data and group export to Excel or PDF
Event registrations can be downloaded in Excel according to the supplier
support: Supplier lists weekday office hours and a UK telephone number

uk-purchasing.value: ChurchBox says it is powered by Church123; Church123's current service terms identify its provider as BlueberryTwist Ltd, registered in England and Wales under number 04254052.

gbp-pricing.value: ChurchBox publishes a free tier and a Full Version at £1 per user per year plus VAT, charged in blocks of ten users.

data-protection-roles.value: ChurchBox describes the church as controller and itself as processor for data held in the service, and says a data-processing agreement is made available to customers.

hosting-and-sub-processors.value: ChurchBox describes a managed cloud service, but this profile has not established its hosting location, provider, sub-processors, recovery arrangements or service levels.

migration.value: Spreadsheet import and several exports are described, but this profile has not established full-record migration, exit export formats, timetable or assistance.

editorial.assessment: ChurchBox is a credible UK option for a church that needs a straightforward directory, communications, event registration and volunteer rota system without immediately paying for a broad suite. The published free tier is useful for a realistic pilot, while the paid per-user modules merit a clear total-cost calculation. Before importing a congregation, the church should obtain the current customer data agreement and test permissions, member consent, rota swaps, reporting and a representative export.
bestFor: Churches wanting a free member-directory and communications starting point
Volunteer-led churches that need availability-aware rotas and simple event registration
Teams looking for a predictable per-user annual GBP model
strengths: Public free tier and simple published paid pricing
UK operator and service terms are identifiable
Relevant core functions for directories, groups, communications, rotas and events
Published controller/processor explanation and customer DPA route
limitations: Confirm hosting, storage geography, security detail, sub-processors, backups and recovery commitments
Pricing is per user in blocks of ten, so calculate the actual annual total including VAT
No current evidence in this profile for finance, Gift Aid, safeguarding-case management or native mobile apps
Confirm full data migration and exit arrangements in writing

procurementVerdict.problem: Replacing a spreadsheet or paper directory while coordinating member communications, events and rotas
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK-managed free directory tier with inexpensive paid modules for the most common volunteer administration workflows
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Create a pilot directory, confirm member visibility and consent settings, build a real rota and event, then review the current DPA and a sample export before loading full records
